name: wds_gtsrb
description: wds_gtsrb is a webdataset-format version of the German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark (GTSRB) used to evaluate image classification models on traffic sign recognition. It measures how accurately models classify images into traffic sign categories under varied real-world conditions. The dataset is commonly used for benchmarking vision models in automotive and safety-related tasks.
reputation: GTSRB is a well-known, widely used benchmark in traffic sign recognition and computer vision research.
